title: Review loop merges through pr land
notes: When review.autoMerge is on, reviewPrompt in src/main/ship/review.ts tells the review worker to wait on CI by hand and run gh pr merge --match-head-commit itself (line ~153). It should run the app's pr land instead, so reviews get its retries on network errors and its check of the PR state after a failed merge call (#304; #301 reported failure though it had merged). Keep autoMerge off behaviour unchanged (stop at green, report). The review loop serves every project: change only the merge step. Update the ship docs. Approved by the user 2026-11-17.
